1. Add accounts and starting balances.

2. Assign money to categories in the Budgeted column. Click an amount to edit it. Enter or Tab moves to the next category.

3. Record income, expenses and transfers in the register. Income without a category increases Available to Budget.

4. Reconcile cleared transactions with bank statements.

5. Review reports and save backups from the File menu.
